entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: Ruler and protector of the Great Wood in the Homelands, an incarnation of the forest's power who grew sentient and gained physical form from Feroz's Ban.

entities.name: Great Wood
entities.description: The forest of the Homelands ruled and protected by the Autumn Willow, embodiment of her will.

entities.name: Homelands
entities.description: The region of Ulgrotha protected from outsiders by Feroz's Ban.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane whose mana channels the Autumn Willow might restart at the cost of every creature in the Homelands.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Caster of the world spell Feroz's Ban; he died, and the ban began to fail.

entities.name: Feroz's Ban
entities.description: The world spell that protected the Homelands from outsiders and backed up mana, empowering the Autumn Willow.

entities.name: Folk of An-Havva
entities.description: The first people to settle in the forest, for whom the Autumn Willow has a motherly affinity.

entities.name: Lady's Path
entities.description: A path the Autumn Willow created for the Folk of An-Havva.

entities.name: Daughter of Autumn
entities.description: A being created by the Autumn Willow, subject of tales across the Homelands.

entities.name: Willow Priestesses
entities.description: Beings tied to the Autumn Willow that people tell of encountering.

entities.name: Spectral Bears
entities.description: Believed personal guardians of the Autumn Willow who escort caravans and make goblins flee.

entities.name: Hungry Mist
entities.description: A creature the Autumn Willow created to watch over the wood.

entities.name: Koskun Mountains
entities.description: Mountains whose goblins raided the human settlers.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Seen in the Autumn Willow's vision leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir.

entities.name: Castle Sengir
entities.description: Castle with a Dwarven Gate beneath it, seen in the Willow's vision.

events.summary: The Autumn Willow grows from a simple forest spirit into a sentient being with physical form because of the mana backed up by Feroz's Ban.
events.quote: the Autumn Willow grew incredibly powerful and achieved sentience and physical form

events.summary: The Autumn Willow meets the first settlers, finds them good, and creates the Lady's Path for the Folk of An-Havva.
events.quote: She created for them the Lady's Path .

events.summary: Facing goblin raids, the Autumn Willow creates new guardians such as the Hungry Mist and faeries to watch over the wood.
events.quote: The Autumn Willow created new creatures from nothingness

events.summary: On the evening Feroz died, the Autumn Willow has a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir.
events.quote: On the evening that Feroz died, the Autumn Willow had a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir .

events.summary: As Feroz's Ban begins to fail, the Autumn Willow feels her sustaining energies fade and agonizes over restarting the plane's mana channels at the cost of all creatures in the Homelands.
events.quote: When Feroz's Ban started to fail, she felt the energies that sustained her begin to fade.

relations.quote: The Autumn Willow is the ruler and protector of the Great Wood in the Homelands .
